column1: 10.1 Prelude
Management Information System (MIS) is a department of the
Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) under the Ministry
of Health and Family Welfare (MOHFW) to ensure an integrated
Health Information System (HIS) through digital transformation
of the health system. In recent years, there have been tremendous
activity and innovations in the development of health information
systems (HIS), encouraged in large part by technological
advancement and use of IT in the Health Sector.

been a vehicle for data systems improvement and other areas of
health systems strengthening overall. Community clinics and
other grassroots-level workers have been provided with laptops
and Android tablets, which are being used to enroll public health-
related information, including those of every pregnant mother and
under-5 child in the programs. Broadband internet connectivity
has been provided to all hospitals from Upazila Health Complex to
Tertiary Level Hospital.
Health information system (HIS) is the backbone of a country’s
health system and needs to focus on individual health records.
Portable electronic health records are being created for all citizens
through the provision of a unique ‘Health ID’ connected to the
National ID and birth registration database. The national digital
health strategy has also been finalized. Medical Colleges and
Hospitals, Specialized Hospitals, Divisional and District health
offices, District Hospitals, and Upazila Hospitals are managing
human resources through digital methods using HRIS (Human
Resource Information System) software, including admission,
human resource management, transfer, promotion, training, leave
etc. Digital office management has been introduced along with
